This notebook is the paper-facing map for the PNAS draft (main text and SI).
It follows the order of the paper. For every figure and table it shows the file used in the paper, the script that produces it and the result itself; for every number quoted in the text it prints the value computed from the saved outputs.

## How to use

- **Full pipeline:** `Rscript main.R` from the repository root runs every script that produces a paper result, in dependency order (about one hour). Set the environment variable `PRINZ_PAPER_DIR` to the LaTeX folder to copy the fresh figures and tables into it; `output/paper_assets_status.csv` then reports what changed.
- **This notebook:** render with all parameters at `FALSE` to read the saved outputs and print every result. Set `run_saved_build = TRUE` to rebuild the outputs from saved `Datasets/` first, and also `run_raw_refresh = TRUE` to rebuild those datasets from the raw data.
- **Check a paper folder:** set `paper_dir` to the LaTeX folder (absolute path or relative to the repository) to flag every figure or table whose paper copy differs from the repository output.
- Rendering outside RStudio needs pandoc: set `RSTUDIO_PANDOC` to RStudio's `resources/app/bin/quarto/bin/tools` folder.
- Numbers marked *static* are typed in the paper and not produced by code; check them by hand when the text changes.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo_root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (exists("params") && is.list(params)) {
  run_saved_build <- isTRUE(params$run_saved_build)
  run_raw_refresh <- isTRUE(params$run_raw_refresh)
  paper_dir <- if (is.null(params$paper_dir)) "" else params$paper_dir
} else {
  run_saved_build <- FALSE
  run_raw_refresh <- FALSE
  paper_dir <- ""
}

assert_required_packages <- function(packages, context) {
  missing <- packages[!vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "[", context, "] Missing required R packages:\n- ",
        paste(sort(unique(missing)), collapse = "\n- "),
        "\n\nInstall the missing packages listed in README.md, then rerun PAPER_REPRODUCTION.Rmd."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

source_script <- function(path) {
  source(file.path(repo_root, path), local = new.env(parent = globalenv()))
}

# Render in a separate R session: a nested render inside this knit would
# share knitr's chunk-label state and fail on duplicate labels (e.g. `setup`).
render_notebook <- function(path) {
  xfun::Rscript_call(
    rmarkdown::render,
    list(input = file.path(repo_root, path), output_format = "html_document",
         quiet = TRUE, clean = TRUE, envir = globalenv())
  )
}

build_flags <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

run_saved_step <- function(key, fun) {
  if (!isTRUE(run_saved_build)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (!exists(key, envir = build_flags, inherits = FALSE)) {
    fun()
    assign(key, TRUE, envir = build_flags)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

run_raw_step <- function(key, fun) {
  if (!isTRUE(run_raw_refresh)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (!exists(key, envir = build_flags, inherits = FALSE)) {
    fun()
    assign(key, TRUE, envir = build_flags)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

source(file.path(repo_root, "paper_assets.R"))

asset_row <- function(item) paper_assets[paper_assets$item == item, ][1, ]

# Print the figure registered under `item`, with its source.
show_asset_figure <- function(item) {
  a <- asset_row(item)
  cat(sprintf("**%s** — paper file `%s`; repo output `%s`; produced by `%s`.\n\n",
              a$item, a$paper_file, a$repo_file, a$script))
  if (file.exists(file.path(repo_root, a$repo_file))) {
    cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", a$item, a$repo_file))
  } else {
    cat("_Output not found. Run `main.R` or this notebook with `run_saved_build = TRUE`._\n\n")
  }
}

# Rows of a LaTeX table: one character vector of cells per data row.
tex_rows <- function(path) {
  x <- readLines(file.path(repo_root, path), warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  x <- trimws(x[grepl("&", x, fixed = TRUE) & grepl("\\\\\\\\\\s*$", x)])
  x <- x[!grepl("multicolumn|begin\\{tabular\\}|shortstack", x)]
  x <- gsub("\\\\\\\\\\s*$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\\\%", "%", x)
  x <- gsub("\\\\checkmark", "x", x)
  x <- gsub("\\$|\\\\hat |\\\\hat|\\\\geq|\\\\leq|\\\\tau|\\\\_", "", x)
  unique(lapply(strsplit(x, "&", fixed = TRUE), trimws))
}

# Print the table registered under `item`, with its source and its values.
show_asset_table <- function(item, col_names = NULL) {
  a <- asset_row(item)
  cat(sprintf("**%s** — paper file `%s`; repo output `%s`; produced by `%s`. %s\n\n",
              a$item, ifelse(is.na(a$paper_file), "(inline)", a$paper_file),
              a$repo_file, a$script, a$note))
  if (!file.exists(file.path(repo_root, a$repo_file))) {
    cat("_Output not found. Run `main.R` or this notebook with `run_saved_build = TRUE`._\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  rows <- tex_rows(a$repo_file)
  n <- max(lengths(rows))
  rows <- rows[lengths(rows) == n]
  m <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  if (is.null(col_names)) {
    col_names <- m[1, ]
    m <- m[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  colnames(m) <- col_names
  print(knitr::kable(m))
  cat("\n\n")
}

# Cell of a LaTeX table: row whose first cell matches `row`, column `col`.
tex_cell <- function(path, row, col) {
  rows <- tex_rows(path)
  hit <- rows[vapply(rows, function(r) identical(r[1], row), logical(1))]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit[[1]][col]
}

pct <- function(x, digits = 0) sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), 100 * x)
num <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)
signed <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf(paste0("%+.", digits, "f"), x)
```

```{r register-status, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nzchar(paper_dir)) {
  status <- check_paper_assets(paper_dir, repo_root)
  cat(sprintf("Status of the paper folder `%s` against the repository outputs:\n\n", paper_dir))
  print(knitr::kable(status[, c("item", "paper_file", "status")],
                     col.names = c("Item", "Paper file", "Status")))
  n_off <- sum(status$status != "up to date")
  cat(sprintf("\n\n%d of %d generated assets differ or are missing. Run `main.R` with `PRINZ_PAPER_DIR` set to copy the current outputs.\n\n",
              n_off, nrow(status)))
} else {
  cat("Set the `paper_dir` parameter to compare a paper folder with these outputs.\n\n")
}
```

## Table 1: cement example

Table 1 is typed in `3-results-CCC.tex`. It applies the reduced-form mapping with ζ = 0.13 and the UK cement Domar weight 0.002 (*static*); each stress test changes one assumption. Recomputed here:

```{r cement, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cement <- function(cost, output = 0, weight = 0.002, zeta = 0.13) {
  a <- zeta * log1p(output) - (1 - zeta) * log1p(cost)
  c(sector = 100 * expm1(a), aggregate = 100 * expm1(weight * a), annual = 100 * weight * a / 28)
}
cement_rows <- list(
  "IEA benchmark" = list(cost = c(0.6, 1.1)),
  "MPP benchmark" = list(cost = c(0.4, 1.2)),
  "McKinsey benchmark" = list(cost = 0.45),
  "Higher cost increase" = list(cost = 2.4),
  "Output doubles" = list(cost = c(0.4, 1.2), output = 1),
  "Higher Domar weight (0.006)" = list(cost = c(0.4, 1.2), weight = 0.006)
)
fmt_range <- function(x, digits, suffix) {
  x <- sort(round(x, digits))
  if (length(unique(x)) == 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%s"), x[1], suffix)
  else sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%s to %.", digits, "f%s"), x[1], suffix, x[2], suffix)
}
cement_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(cement_rows), function(nm) {
  r <- cement_rows[[nm]]
  v <- sapply(r$cost, function(c) cement(c, ifelse(is.null(r$output), 0, r$output),
                                          ifelse(is.null(r$weight), 0.002, r$weight)))
  v <- matrix(v, nrow = 3)
  data.frame(
    Scenario = nm,
    `Cost increase` = paste0(100 * r$cost, "%", collapse = "–"),
    `Sectoral TFP` = fmt_range(v[1, ], 0, "%"),
    `Aggregate by 2050` = fmt_range(v[2, ], 2, "%"),
    `Annual (%/yr)` = fmt_range(v[3, ], 3, ""),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))
print(knitr::kable(cement_tab))
all_annual <- unlist(lapply(names(cement_rows), function(nm) {
  r <- cement_rows[[nm]]
  sapply(r$cost, function(c) cement(c, ifelse(is.null(r$output), 0, r$output),
                                     ifelse(is.null(r$weight), 0.002, r$weight))["annual"])
}))
cat(sprintf("\n\nWith 1%% baseline TFP growth, the cement transition leaves growth between %.3f%% and %.3f%%.\n\n",
            1 + min(all_annual), 1 + max(all_annual)))
```

Numbers in `4-results-energy.tex` (ζ in the energy notebook: `r etn$zeta`):

- World Fast Transition: energy-sector TFP `r pct(world_gain, 1)`, Domar weight `r num(etn$world_domar_useful, 3)`, aggregate `r num(100 * world_agg, 2)` pp (`r num(100 * world_agg / 28, 3)` pp/year).
- Without stationary batteries: `r pct(stor("World Fast Transition", "Excluded", "Energy-sector TFP gain"), 1)` (`r num(100 * stor("World Fast Transition", "Excluded", "Aggregate TFP gain"), 1)` pp) globally; `r pct(stor("UK Fast Transition", "Excluded", "Energy-sector TFP gain"), 1)` (`r num(100 * stor("UK Fast Transition", "Excluded", "Aggregate TFP gain"), 2)` pp) in the UK Fast Transition.
- UK Fast Transition: `r pct(uk_gain, 1)`, Domar weight `r num(etn$uk_domar_useful, 3)`, ln(`r num(1 + uk_gain, 3)`) × `r num(etn$uk_domar_useful, 3)` = `r num(uk_contribution, 4)`, i.e. `r num(100 * uk_contribution, 2)` pp (`r num(100 * uk_contribution / 28, 3)` pp/year).
- CCC Balanced Net Zero: `r pct(ccc_gain, 1)`, aggregate `r num(100 * ccc_agg, 2)` pp (`r num(100 * ccc_agg / 28, 3)` pp/year).
- World–UK gap: `r num(etn$uk_world_useful_gap_logbp / 100, 1)` log points = initial prices `r num(etn$uk_world_useful_initial_price_logbp / 100, 1)` + solar-to-wind mix `r num(etn$uk_world_useful_mix_logbp / 100, 1)` + useful-energy demand `r num(etn$uk_world_useful_quantity_logbp / 100, 1)` + residual `r num(etn$uk_world_useful_residual_logbp / 100, 1)`.
- CCC abated gas and biomass in 2050: `r pct(etn$ccc_bnz_abated_share_2050, 1)` of final energy.
- Batteries in 2050: `r num(etn$uk_fast_battery_capacity_gwh_2050, 0)` GWh in the UK Fast Transition against `r num(etn$ccc_bnz_storage_capacity_gwh_2050, 1)` GWh from the CCC storage flow.
- Final rather than useful energy: `r pct(final_energy("UK fast transition"))` (UK Fast), `r pct(final_energy("Balanced Net Zero Pathway"))` (CCC), `r pct(final_energy("Fast_Transition"))` (World Fast).
- Literature context: real wages 2–3% and labour productivity +0.3% per 1% green-investment efficiency (*static*).

## Section 5: empirical validation (Figs. S1–S9, Tables S3–S6)

```{r validation-build, eval=run_saved_build}
run_saved_step("validation", function() {
  render_notebook("2.1 Hindcasting_zeta.Rmd")
  render_notebook("2.2 Hindcasting_Domar_agg.Rmd")
  source_script("2.3 regressing_zeta.R")
  source_script("2.4_cross_sector_pairwise_correlation.R")
  source_script("2.5_Hindcasting_joint_zeta_Domar_KLEMS.R")
})
```

Numbers in `A6-Empirical_validation.tex`:

- Domar aggregation at horizon 20: mean error `r num(100 * domar_h20$mean_error, 1)` pp, 10–90 range `r num(100 * domar_h20$q10, 1)` to `r num(100 * domar_h20$q90, 1)` pp; `r domar_support$n_h20[1]` country–origin observations at horizon 20 (`r domar_support$n_last[1]` at horizon `r domar_support$horizon_last[1]`).
- Baseline ζ = `r num(zeta_baseline, 3)`; accuracy objectives give `r num(klems_accuracy_range[1], 3)`–`r num(klems_accuracy_range[2], 3)` in KLEMS and `r num(nber_accuracy_range[1], 3)`–`r num(nber_accuracy_range[2], 3)` in NBER CES; nominal-output weighting gives `r num(klems_output_weighted, 3)`.
- Horizon-`r klems_h30$horizon` KLEMS error (extrapolated from horizons 11–20): median `r num(klems_h30$q50, 4)`, 10–90 range `r num(klems_h30$q10, 3)` to `r num(klems_h30$q90, 3)` in log.
- Fixed-effect regression at horizon 18: `r s5_coef[2]` without and `r s5_coef[length(s5_coef)]` with country, sector and year fixed effects (N = `r s5_n[2]`). Horizon-by-horizon checks 0.195 (15), 0.129 (18), 0.132 (20), 0.130 (23) are *static* (from `2.3 regressing_zeta.R` output).
- Joint ζ–Domar calibration: long-horizon aggregate MAE ζ = `r num(joint_long_mae, 3)`; steps from the sector-level baseline: `r paste(sprintf("%s %.3f", decomp_long_mae$step, decomp_long_mae$zeta), collapse = "; ")`.

## Section 6: CCC scenarios (Table S7, Fig. S10)

Numbers in `B1-CCC.tex`:

- CB7 total `r signed(cb7_2050, 2)` pp; CB6 from `r num(cb6_2050["Widespread Engagement"], 2)` (Widespread Engagement) to `r num(cb6_2050["Tailwinds"], 2)` pp (Tailwinds); Balanced Net Zero `r num(cb6_2050["Balanced Net Zero Pathway"], 2)` pp.
- Surface transport: `r signed(min(surface_cb6), 2)` to `r signed(max(surface_cb6), 2)` pp in CB6, `r signed(s7("Surface transport", 2), 2)` pp in CB7. CB7 residential `r num(s7("Res buildings", 2), 2)`, removals `r num(s7("Removals", 2), 2)`, non-residential `r num(s7("Non res buildings", 2), 2)` pp.
- Electricity supply: `r signed(s7("Electricity supply", 3), 2)` (CB6 Balanced Net Zero), `r signed(s7("Electricity supply", 2), 2)` (CB7), `r num(s7("Electricity supply", 4), 2)` (Headwinds), `r num(s7("Electricity supply", 5), 2)` (Tailwinds), `r num(s7("Electricity supply", 7), 2)` (Widespread Innovation) pp.
- Quantity-growth illustration: ζ ln(1.338) = `r num(100 * quantity_sector, 1)` log points per sector, × `r num(ccc_domar_sum, 2)` = `r num(100 * ccc_domar_sum * quantity_sector, 1)` log points; cancels against the reference path.
- Error propagation: CCC sectors' Domar weight `r num(ccc_domar_sum, 2)`, share of total `r num(ccc_domar_share, 2)`; CB7 bands in 2050: 25–75 `r pct(cb7_band$q25_cumAhat, 2)` to `r pct(cb7_band$q75_cumAhat, 2)`, 10–90 `r pct(cb7_band$q10_cumAhat, 2)` to `r pct(cb7_band$q90_cumAhat, 2)`.
- Supporting, not quoted in the paper: financing-cost sensitivity of CB7 `r num(ccc_cb7_financing_summary$aggregate_effect_pp[ccc_cb7_financing_summary$financing_rate == 0][1], 2)` pp (no financing), `r num(ccc_cb7_financing_summary$aggregate_effect_pp[ccc_cb7_financing_summary$financing_rate == 0.035][1], 2)` pp (3.5%), `r num(ccc_cb7_financing_summary$aggregate_effect_pp[ccc_cb7_financing_summary$financing_rate == 0.15][1], 2)` pp (15%).

## Section 7: energy (Tables S8–S13, Figs. S11–S12)

Numbers in `B2-energy.tex`:

- Grid adder: without it, `r pct(etn$no_grid_tfp_uk_fast)` instead of `r pct(uk_gain)` (UK Fast), `r pct(etn$no_grid_tfp_ccc_bnz)` instead of `r pct(ccc_gain)` (CCC), `r pct(req("World Fast Transition", grid = 0))` instead of `r pct(world_gain)` (World). In 2050 wind is `r num(etn$wind_price_2050, 1)` USD/MWh (`r num(wind_over, 1)` with overgeneration), solar `r num(etn$solar_price_2050, 1)` (`r num(solar_over, 1)`); the 7 USD/MWh adder adds `r pct(7 / wind_over)` and `r pct(7 / solar_over)`.
- Energy total check: a constant 6% level gap scales the CCC aggregate effect from `r num(100 * ccc_agg, 2)` to about `r num(106 * ccc_agg, 2)` pp. UK 2022 energy 170 Mtoe vs 1866 TWh (*static*).
- CCC storage: 2050 flow `r num(etn$ccc_bnz_storage_flow_twh_2050, 2)` TWh, `r num(etn$ccc_bnz_storage_capacity_gwh_2050, 1)` GWh of capacity, 1/`r num(etn$uk_fast_battery_capacity_gwh_2050 / etn$ccc_bnz_storage_capacity_gwh_2050, 0)` of the UK Fast Transition (`r num(etn$uk_fast_battery_capacity_gwh_2050 / 1000, 2)` TWh).
- CCC CB6 range: `r pct(min(sapply(c("Balanced Net Zero Pathway", "Headwinds", "Widespread Engagement", "Widespread Innovation", "Tailwinds"), function(s) req(paste("CCC CB6", s)))))` to `r pct(max(sapply(c("Balanced Net Zero Pathway", "Headwinds", "Widespread Engagement", "Widespread Innovation", "Tailwinds"), function(s) req(paste("CCC CB6", s)))))` energy-sector TFP; Balanced Net Zero `r pct(req("CCC CB6 Balanced Net Zero Pathway"))` and `r pct(req("CCC CB6 Balanced Net Zero Pathway", "Aggregate TFP gain"), 1)` aggregate.
- Fixed 2022 mix: UK `r pct(req("UK Fixed 2022 Energy Mix"))` (`r pct(req("UK Fixed 2022 Energy Mix", "Aggregate TFP gain"), 1)` aggregate); World `r pct(req("World Fixed 2022 Energy Mix"))` (`r pct(req("World Fixed 2022 Energy Mix", "Aggregate TFP gain"), 1)`). No Transition `r pct(req("World No Transition"))` (`r pct(req("World No Transition", "Aggregate TFP gain"), 1)`); Fast Transition `r pct(world_gain)` (`r pct(world_agg, 1)`).
- Way et al. cost check (all-Way prices): USD `r num(way_2022, 2)` and `r num(way_2050, 2)` trillion in 2022 and 2050; without overgeneration `r num(way_2022_no_over, 2)` and `r num(way_2050_no_over, 2)`; overgeneration `r pct((way_2050 - way_2050_no_over) / way_2050)` of 2050 costs. Way et al. report 4.04 and 4.96 (*static*).
- All-Way prices: UK Balanced Net Zero `r pct(req("UK Balanced Net Zero Scenario", calib = "All Way"))` (`r pct(req("UK Balanced Net Zero Scenario", "Aggregate TFP gain", calib = "All Way"), 1)`); World Fast `r pct(req("World Fast Transition", calib = "All Way"))` (`r pct(req("World Fast Transition", "Aggregate TFP gain", calib = "All Way"), 1)`).
- No overgeneration: `r pct(overgen(1, "World Fast Transition"))` (World), `r pct(overgen(1, "UK Fast Transition"))` (UK Fast), `r pct(overgen(1, "UK Balanced Net Zero Scenario"))` (CCC).
- Storage costs: 2050 price `r num(stor("World Fast Transition", "Included", "price_2050"), 1)` → `r num(stor("World Fast Transition", "Excluded", "price_2050"), 1)` (World), `r num(stor("UK Fast Transition", "Included", "price_2050"), 1)` → `r num(stor("UK Fast Transition", "Excluded", "price_2050"), 1)` (UK Fast), `r num(stor("CCC Balanced Net Zero", "Included", "price_2050"), 1)` → `r num(stor("CCC Balanced Net Zero", "Excluded", "price_2050"), 1)` (CCC) USD/MWh; gains `r pct(world_gain, 1)` → `r pct(stor("World Fast Transition", "Excluded", "Energy-sector TFP gain"), 1)`, `r pct(uk_gain, 1)` → `r pct(stor("UK Fast Transition", "Excluded", "Energy-sector TFP gain"), 1)`, `r pct(ccc_gain, 1)` → `r pct(stor("CCC Balanced Net Zero", "Excluded", "Energy-sector TFP gain"), 1)`.
- Electricity production costs (89 and 120 USD/MWh), retail-price comparisons and the 1.5 overgeneration, 0.5 hydrogen efficiency and 14 USD/MWh plant adder are *static* inputs.
